unitChecks.sourceWitness: 道濟固壘不戰，紹乃攻其西營，不克，遂以大眾逼之。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Daoji stays behind his works; Shao fails to take his western camp, then presses him with the main force.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 道濟率王敬、沈林子等逆沖紹軍，將士驚散，引還定城。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Daoji charges with Wang Jing and Shen Linzi; Shao’s men scatter in alarm and withdraw to Dingcheng.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 紹留姚鸞守險，絕道濟糧道。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Shao leaves Luan to hold a strategic position and cut Daoji’s grain route.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 時裕別將姚珍入自子午，竇霸入自洛穀，眾各數千人。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Liu Yu’s commanders Zhen and Ba lead several thousand apiece through Ziwu and Luogu respectively.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 泓遣姚萬距霸，姚彊距珍。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hong sends Wan against Ba and Qiang against Zhen.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 姚鸞遣將尹雅與道濟司馬徐琰于潼關南，為琰所獲，送之劉裕。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Luan sends Yin Ya against Daoji’s major Xu Yan south of Tong Pass; Yan captures him and sends him to Liu Yu.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 裕以雅前叛，欲殺之。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Liu Yu considers executing Ya for his previous defection.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 雅曰：「前活本在望外，今死寧不甘心。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Ya says his earlier survival exceeded his hopes and he would willingly accept death now.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 明公將以大義平天下，豈可使秦無守信之臣乎！」
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Ya challenges whether Liu Yu, claiming to pacify the realm by righteousness, can deny Qin faithful ministers.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 裕嘉而免之。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Liu Yu commends and spares him.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 泓遣給事黃門侍郎姚和都屯于堯柳，以備田子。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hong stations Yao Hedu at Yaoliu to guard against Tianzi.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 姚紹謂諸將曰：「道濟等遠來送死，眾旅不多，嬰壘自固者，正欲曠日持久，以待繼援耳。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Shao says Daoji’s small force came far to die and keeps to its ramparts only to await reinforcements.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 吾欲分軍還據閿鄉，以絕其糧運，不至一月，道濟之首可懸之麾下矣。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Shao proposes a detachment to reoccupy Wenxiang and cut grain transport; he predicts Daoji’s head within a month.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 濟等既沒，裕計自沮。」
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Destroying Daoji and the others would frustrate Liu Yu’s plan.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 諸將咸以為然。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: All the generals agree.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 其將胡翼度曰：「軍勢宜集不可以分，若偏師不利，人心駭懼，胡可以戰！」
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hu Yidu objects that loss of a detachment would spread fear through the army and make battle impossible.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 紹乃止。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Shao abandons that plan.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 薛帛據河曲以叛。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Xue Bo occupies the river bend in revolt.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 紹分道置諸軍為掎角之勢，遣輔國胡翼度據東原，武衛姚鸞營于大路，與晉軍相接。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Shao positions mutually supporting commands, putting Hu Yidu on the eastern plain and Luan on the main road close to Jin.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 沈林子簡精銳銜枚夜襲之，鸞眾潰戰死，士卒死者九千餘人。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Linzi selects elite troops for a silent night attack; Luan dies in the rout and more than nine thousand soldiers perish.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 姚贊屯於河上，遣恢武姚難運蒲阪穀以給其軍，至香城，為王師所敗。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Zan camps on the Yellow River and sends Nan with Puban grain; at Xiangcheng the Jin army defeats Nan.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 時泓遣姚諶守堯柳，姚和都討薛帛於河東，聞王師要難，乃兼道赴救，未至而難敗，固破裕裨將于河曲，遂屯蒲阪。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Chen guards Yaoliu while Hedu attacks Bo in Hedong; Hedu hurries to relieve Nan, defeats Liu Yu’s subordinate at the bend and camps at Puban.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 姚贊為林子所敗，單馬奔定城。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Defeated by Linzi, Zan flees alone on horseback to Dingcheng.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 紹遣左長史姚洽及姚墨蠡等率騎三千屯于河北之九原，欲絕道濟諸縣租輸。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Shao sends Qia, Moli and others with three thousand cavalry to cut county tax-grain deliveries from Jiuyuan.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 洽辭曰：「夫小敵之堅，大敵之擒。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Qia objects that a small force standing firm can be captured by a larger one.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 今兵眾單弱，而遠在河外，雖明公神武，然鞭短勢殊，恐無所及。」
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Qia warns their weak force will be beyond the river and beyond even Shao’s ability to relieve.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 紹不聽。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Shao disregards his warning.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 沈林子率眾八千，耍洽於河上，洽戰死，眾皆沒。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Linzi intercepts Qia with eight thousand men; Qia dies in action and his whole force is lost.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 紹聞洽等敗，忿恚發病，托姚贊以後事，使姚難屯關西，紹嘔血而死。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Shao falls ill from anger at the defeat, entrusts affairs to Zan, stations Nan west of the pass, vomits blood and dies.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 泓以晉師之逼，遣使乞師于魏。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Pressed by Jin, Hong sends envoys asking Wei for troops.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 魏遣司徒、南平公拔拔嵩，正直將軍、安平公乙旃眷，進據河內，遊擊將軍王洛生屯於河東，為泓聲援。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Wei sends two dukes to Henei and stations the raiding general Wang Luosheng in Hedong to support Hong.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 劉裕次於陝城，遣沈林子率精兵萬餘，越山開道，會沈田子等於青泥，將攻堯柳。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Liu Yu stops at Shan city; Linzi opens a mountain route with over ten thousand elite troops for the rendezvous at Qingni and attack on Yaoliu.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 泓使姚裕率步騎八千距之，泓躬將大眾繼發。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hong sends Yu ahead with eight thousand infantry and cavalry and personally leads the main army after him.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 裕為田子所敗，泓退次於灞上，關中郡縣多潛通于王師。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Tianzi defeats Yao Yu; Hong retires to Bashang, and many Guanzhong jurisdictions secretly communicate with Jin.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 劉裕至潼關，遣將軍硃超石、徐猗之會薛帛于河北，以攻蒲阪。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Liu Yu reaches Tong Pass and sends Zhu Chaoshi and Xu Yizhi to join Xue Bo north of the Yellow River for an attack on Puban.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 姚贊距裕于關西，姚難屯於香城。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Zan opposes Liu Yu west of the pass, and Nan camps at Xiangcheng.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 裕遣王鎮惡、王敬自秋社西渡渭，以逼難軍。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Zhen’e and Wang Jing set out west from Qiushe, cross the Wei and press Nan.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 鎮東姚璞及姚和都擊敗猗之等於蒲阪，猗之遇害，超石棄其眾奔於潼關。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Pu and Hedu defeat Yizhi’s party at Puban; Yizhi is killed and Chaoshi abandons his men for Tong Pass.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 姚贊遣司馬休之及司馬國璠自軹關向河內，引魏軍以躡裕後。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Zan sends Sima Xiuzhi and Sima Guofan from Zhiguan toward Henei to bring Wei forces up behind Liu Yu.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 姚難既為鎮惡所逼，引師而西。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Pressed by Zhen’e, Nan draws his army west.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 時大霖雨，渭水泛溢，贊等不得北渡。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Heavy rains flood the Wei and keep Zan and the others from crossing north.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 鎮惡水陸兼進，追及姚難。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Zhen’e advances on land and water and overtakes Nan.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 泓自灞上還軍，次於石橋以援之。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Hong brings his army back from Bashang and camps at Stone Bridge to support Nan.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 贊退屯鄭城。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Zan withdraws and camps at Zhengcheng.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 鎮北姚彊率郡人數千，與姚難陣於涇上，以距鎮惡。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Qiang leads several thousand local men and arrays with Nan on the Jing to resist Zhen’e.

unitChecks.sourceWitness: 鎮惡遣毛德祖擊彊，大敗，彊戰死，難遁還長安。
unitChecks.checkedPropositions: Zhen’e sends Dezu, who routs Qiang; Qiang dies fighting, and Nan flees back to Chang’an.

repairs.before: Daoji led Wang Chong, Shen Linzi and others to charge straight at Shao's army; officers and soldiers startled and scattered, drew back to Dingcheng.
repairs.after: Daoji led Wang Jing, Shen Linzi and others in a charge against Shao’s army. Shao’s officers and men scattered in alarm and fell back to Dingcheng.
repairs.sourceWitness: 道濟率王敬、沈林子等逆沖紹軍，將士驚散，引還定城。
repairs.sourceReason: The name in both this unit and s0222 is 王敬 (Wang Jing), not Wang Chong. Shao’s men are the ones who scatter.

repairs.before: Yao Shao left Yao Luan to choke Tan Daoji's supply line.
repairs.after: Yao Shao left Yao Luan to hold the narrows and cut Tan Daoji’s grain route.
repairs.sourceWitness: 紹留姚鸞守險，絕道濟糧道。
repairs.sourceReason: 守險 is holding a strategic position in order to cut the supply route.

repairs.before: Liu Yu's columns entered from Ziwu and Luogu valleys.
repairs.after: Liu Yu’s detachment commanders Yao Zhen and Dou Ba led separate forces of several thousand men each, Yao Zhen entering by Ziwu and Dou Ba by Luogu.
repairs.sourceWitness: 時裕別將姚珍入自子午，竇霸入自洛穀，眾各數千人。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore both commanders’ names, their different routes and the several thousand men under each.

repairs.before: Yao Hong sent Yao Wan and Yao Qiang to meet them.
repairs.after: Yao Hong sent Yao Wan to oppose Dou Ba and Yao Qiang to oppose Yao Zhen.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓遣姚萬距霸，姚彊距珍。
repairs.sourceReason: The order names Wan’s opponent as Dou Ba and Qiang’s as Yao Zhen.

repairs.before: Yin Ya was captured by Xu Yan and sent to Liu Yu.
repairs.after: Yao Luan sent his general Yin Ya against Xu Yan, Tan Daoji’s major, south of Tong Pass. Xu Yan captured Yin Ya and sent him to Liu Yu.
repairs.sourceWitness: 姚鸞遣將尹雅與道濟司馬徐琰于潼關南，為琰所獲，送之劉裕。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Luan’s dispatch of his general, Xu Yan’s office under Daoji and the encounter’s location.

repairs.before: Yin Ya said: "You spared me once; now I will not beg like a coward.
repairs.after: Yin Ya said, “Surviving the first time was already more than I had hoped for. How could I be unwilling to die now?
repairs.sourceWitness: 雅曰：「前活本在望外，今死寧不甘心。
repairs.sourceReason: 寧不甘心 is a rhetorical affirmative: Ya is willing to die since his earlier survival had already exceeded his hopes. Neither a previous act of clemency by Liu Yu nor cowardice is stated. The parallel Zizhi tongjian 118 reads 至今死固甘心.

repairs.before: Ya said, "Formerly living was already beyond expectation; now death surely I do not willingly accept.
repairs.after: Yin Ya said, “Surviving the first time was already more than I had hoped for. How could I be unwilling to die now?
repairs.sourceWitness: 雅曰：「前活本在望外，今死寧不甘心。
repairs.sourceReason: 寧不甘心 is a rhetorical affirmative: Ya is willing to die since his earlier survival had already exceeded his hopes. Neither a previous act of clemency by Liu Yu nor cowardice is stated. The parallel Zizhi tongjian 118 reads 至今死固甘心.

repairs.before: You claim to conquer by virtue—do not kill the one Qin man who keeps faith!"
repairs.after: You intend to pacify the realm through great righteousness. How can you deny Qin a minister who keeps faith with his ruler?”
repairs.sourceWitness: 明公將以大義平天下，豈可使秦無守信之臣乎！」
repairs.sourceReason: Ya asks how Liu Yu could deny Qin the right to have loyal servants; he does not claim to be its only loyal man.

repairs.before: Yao Hong posted Yao Hedou at Yaoliu against Shen Tianzi.
repairs.after: Hong sent Yao Hedu, an attendant gentleman of the Yellow Gates, to encamp at Yaoliu as a precaution against Shen Tianzi.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓遣給事黃門侍郎姚和都屯于堯柳，以備田子。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Hedu’s court office. 和都 is Hedu (都, dū), not Hedou; he recurs in s0207 and s0223.

repairs.before: Hong sent attendant gentleman Huangmen Yao Hedou to camp at Yaoliu to prepare for Tianzi.
repairs.after: Hong sent Yao Hedu, an attendant gentleman of the Yellow Gates, to encamp at Yaoliu as a precaution against Shen Tianzi.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓遣給事黃門侍郎姚和都屯于堯柳，以備田子。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Hedu’s court office. 和都 is Hedu (都, dū), not Hedou; he recurs in s0207 and s0223.

repairs.before: Yao Shao told his generals: "Jin hugs its walls waiting for reinforcements.
repairs.after: Yao Shao told his generals, “Daoji and the others have come a long way to their deaths. Their forces are small. They cling to their ramparts to defend themselves only because they want to gain time until reinforcements arrive.
repairs.sourceWitness: 姚紹謂諸將曰：「道濟等遠來送死，眾旅不多，嬰壘自固者，正欲曠日持久，以待繼援耳。
repairs.sourceReason: 送死 means they have come to their deaths, not to deliver death. Shao notes their long march and small numbers and explains their defensive delay.

repairs.before: Yao Shao said to the generals, "Daoji and others have come from afar to deliver death; their hosts are not many; hugging ramparts and self-fortifying—they only wish to prolong days and months to await follow-up relief.
repairs.after: Yao Shao told his generals, “Daoji and the others have come a long way to their deaths. Their forces are small. They cling to their ramparts to defend themselves only because they want to gain time until reinforcements arrive.
repairs.sourceWitness: 姚紹謂諸將曰：「道濟等遠來送死，眾旅不多，嬰壘自固者，正欲曠日持久，以待繼援耳。
repairs.sourceReason: 送死 means they have come to their deaths, not to deliver death. Shao notes their long march and small numbers and explains their defensive delay.

repairs.before: Send a column to Wenxiang to sever their supplies and Tan Daoji's head will be on your pole within a month.
repairs.after: I want to send part of our army back to hold Wenxiang and cut their grain transport. Before a month has passed, Daoji’s head can hang beneath my standard.
repairs.sourceWitness: 吾欲分軍還據閿鄉，以絕其糧運，不至一月，道濟之首可懸之麾下矣。
repairs.sourceReason: Shao proposes dividing his own force and sending it back to occupy Wenxiang; 麾下 is under his standard, not the hearer’s pole.

repairs.before: Kill Tan Daoji and Liu Yu loses his spear point."
repairs.after: Once Daoji and the others are destroyed, Liu Yu’s plans will come to nothing.”
repairs.sourceWitness: 濟等既沒，裕計自沮。」
repairs.sourceReason: The prediction concerns Daoji and his companions and the consequent frustration of Liu Yu’s plans.

repairs.before: Yao Shao spread his wings: Hu Yidu on the east plain, Yao Luan on the main road, pressing Jin.
repairs.after: Shao positioned his armies along separate routes so they could support each other. He sent Hu Yidu, General Who Supports the State, to hold the eastern plain and Martial Guard commander Yao Luan to encamp on the main road, in contact with the Jin army.
repairs.sourceWitness: 紹分道置諸軍為掎角之勢，遣輔國胡翼度據東原，武衛姚鸞營于大路，與晉軍相接。
repairs.sourceReason: Shao disposes forces along different routes in mutually supporting positions; both named generals’ offices and their proximity to the Jin army belong to that deployment.

repairs.before: Shao divided roads and set various armies in horn-and-flank posture, sent General Who Supports the State Hu Yidu to hold the eastern plain, Martial Guard Yao Luan to camp on the great road, connecting with the Jin army.
repairs.after: Shao positioned his armies along separate routes so they could support each other. He sent Hu Yidu, General Who Supports the State, to hold the eastern plain and Martial Guard commander Yao Luan to encamp on the main road, in contact with the Jin army.
repairs.sourceWitness: 紹分道置諸軍為掎角之勢，遣輔國胡翼度據東原，武衛姚鸞營于大路，與晉軍相接。
repairs.sourceReason: Shao disposes forces along different routes in mutually supporting positions; both named generals’ offices and their proximity to the Jin army belong to that deployment.

repairs.before: Shen Linzi night-attacked; Yao Luan fell with nine thousand men.
repairs.after: Shen Linzi picked elite troops and had them hold gags in their mouths to keep silent during a night attack. Yao Luan’s force broke and he died in battle. More than nine thousand soldiers were killed.
repairs.sourceWitness: 沈林子簡精銳銜枚夜襲之，鸞眾潰戰死，士卒死者九千餘人。
repairs.sourceReason: 銜枚 is silencing soldiers with mouth gags for the surprise raid. Luan’s troops rout, Luan is killed in battle, and more than nine thousand soldiers die.

repairs.before: Shen Linzi picked crack troops, held mouthpieces for a night raid; Luan's host broke in battle and died; more than nine thousand soldiers died.
repairs.after: Shen Linzi picked elite troops and had them hold gags in their mouths to keep silent during a night attack. Yao Luan’s force broke and he died in battle. More than nine thousand soldiers were killed.
repairs.sourceWitness: 沈林子簡精銳銜枚夜襲之，鸞眾潰戰死，士卒死者九千餘人。
repairs.sourceReason: 銜枚 is silencing soldiers with mouth gags for the surprise raid. Luan’s troops rout, Luan is killed in battle, and more than nine thousand soldiers die.

repairs.before: Yao Zan tried to ship grain from Puban but Jin smashed the train at Xiangcheng.
repairs.after: Yao Zan camped on the Yellow River and sent Yao Nan, General Who Restores Might, to bring grain from Puban to supply his army. When Nan reached Xiangcheng, the Jin army defeated him.
repairs.sourceWitness: 姚贊屯於河上，遣恢武姚難運蒲阪穀以給其軍，至香城，為王師所敗。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Zan’s camp on the Yellow River, the dispatch of General Yao Nan with the grain, and Nan as the defeated commander.

repairs.before: Yao Chen raced to save Yao Nan, missed him, but beat a Jin column in the bend and held Puban.
repairs.after: Hong had sent Yao Chen to guard Yaoliu and Yao Hedu to attack Xue Bo in Hedong. When Hedu heard that the Jin army was intercepting Yao Nan, he hurried by forced marches to help. Nan was defeated before Hedu arrived, but Hedu then defeated a subordinate general of Liu Yu’s at the bend of the Yellow River and camped at Puban.
repairs.sourceWitness: 時泓遣姚諶守堯柳，姚和都討薛帛於河東，聞王師要難，乃兼道赴救，未至而難敗，固破裕裨將于河曲，遂屯蒲阪。
repairs.sourceReason: Chen guards Yaoliu. Hedu is the active commander in Hedong and hurries to Nan, then defeats the subordinate and camps at Puban. 兼道 is forced marching. A Jinshu witness reads 因破, and the Shanxi tongzhi account explicitly identifies Hedu. https://www.shidianguji.com/zh/book/HY2973/chapter/1kr2z1v9jqtrb https://www.shidianguji.com/zh/book/NGJ8924120000138615052/chapter/1lw0pf656savv

repairs.before: At the time Hong had sent Yao Chen to guard Yaoliu, Yao Hedou campaigned against Xue Bo in Hedong; hearing the royal army was intercepting Nan, they hurried by combined roads to rescue; before arriving Nan was defeated, yet they broke Liu Yu's lieutenant at the river bend, then camped at Puban.
repairs.after: Hong had sent Yao Chen to guard Yaoliu and Yao Hedu to attack Xue Bo in Hedong. When Hedu heard that the Jin army was intercepting Yao Nan, he hurried by forced marches to help. Nan was defeated before Hedu arrived, but Hedu then defeated a subordinate general of Liu Yu’s at the bend of the Yellow River and camped at Puban.

repairs.before: Yao Shao sent Yao Qia to Jiuyuan to choke Tan Daoji's supply convoys.
repairs.after: Yao Shao sent his left chief clerk Yao Qia, Yao Moli and others with three thousand cavalry to camp at Jiuyuan north of the Yellow River. He meant to cut off the tax-grain shipments that the counties were sending Tan Daoji.
repairs.sourceWitness: 紹遣左長史姚洽及姚墨蠡等率騎三千屯于河北之九原，欲絕道濟諸縣租輸。
repairs.sourceReason: The detachment includes left chief clerk Qia, Moli and others with three thousand horse. Jiuyuan lies north of the Yellow River; the supplies are county tax shipments for Daoji.

repairs.before: Yao Qia refused: "A small force that stands stubborn becomes bait.
repairs.after: Yao Qia objected, “A small force that stands its ground becomes the captive of a larger enemy.
repairs.sourceWitness: 洽辭曰：「夫小敵之堅，大敵之擒。
repairs.sourceReason: The warning is that stubborn resistance makes a small force the captive of a large enemy, not bait for it.

repairs.before: We are too few and too far—even you cannot stretch a whip across the river."
repairs.after: Our troops are few and weak, far away beyond the Yellow River. For all your military prowess, my lord, your whip is short and the forces unequal. I fear you will be unable to reach us.”
repairs.sourceWitness: 今兵眾單弱，而遠在河外，雖明公神武，然鞭短勢殊，恐無所及。」
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Qia’s praise of Shao, the force imbalance and his fear that relief could not reach them.

repairs.before: Shen Linzi destroyed Yao Qia on the riverbank.
repairs.after: Shen Linzi led eight thousand men to intercept Yao Qia on the Yellow River. Qia died in battle and his entire force was lost.
repairs.sourceWitness: 沈林子率眾八千，耍洽於河上，洽戰死，眾皆沒。
repairs.sourceReason: Linzi led eight thousand men, not eight thousand armies; Qia died in battle and all his force was lost.

repairs.before: Shen Linzi led eight thousand hosts, intercepted Qia on the river; Qia died in battle, the host all perished.
repairs.after: Shen Linzi led eight thousand men to intercept Yao Qia on the Yellow River. Qia died in battle and his entire force was lost.
repairs.sourceWitness: 沈林子率眾八千，耍洽於河上，洽戰死，眾皆沒。
repairs.sourceReason: Linzi led eight thousand men, not eight thousand armies; Qia died in battle and all his force was lost.

repairs.before: Yao Shao died of rage and bleeding after Yao Qia's loss.
repairs.after: When Yao Shao learned of the defeat of Yao Qia and the others, his anger brought on an illness. He entrusted affairs to Yao Zan and sent Yao Nan to encamp west of the pass. Shao vomited blood and died.
repairs.sourceWitness: 紹聞洽等敗，忿恚發病，托姚贊以後事，使姚難屯關西，紹嘔血而死。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Shao’s illness, entrusting affairs to Zan, sending Nan west of the pass, and vomiting blood.

repairs.before: Yao Hong begged Northern Wei for aid against Jin.
repairs.after: As the Jin army pressed closer, Yao Hong sent envoys to Wei to ask for troops.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓以晉師之逼，遣使乞師于魏。
repairs.sourceReason: Hong made the request by sending envoys; he sought troops.

repairs.before: Wei sent Minister of Education Duke of Nanping Baba Song, Straight General Duke of Anping Yizhan Juan, and Raiding General Wang Luosheng to occupy Henei and Hedong as support for Yao Hong.
repairs.after: Wei sent Baba Song, minister of education and Duke of Nanping, and Yizhan Juan, Upright General and Duke of Anping, to advance and occupy Henei. Raiding General Wang Luosheng camped in Hedong to support Hong.
repairs.sourceWitness: 魏遣司徒、南平公拔拔嵩，正直將軍、安平公乙旃眷，進據河內，遊擊將軍王洛生屯於河東，為泓聲援。
repairs.sourceReason: Two dukes advance into Henei. Wang Luosheng alone is assigned Hedong. The literal instead implies that all three occupied Henei; the idiomatic conflates the assignments.

repairs.before: Wei sent Minister of Education Duke of Nanping Baba Song, Straight General Duke of Anping Yizhan Juan, and Raiding General Wang Luosheng; they advanced to occupy Henei, and Wang Luosheng camped in Hedong, as sounding support for Hong.
repairs.after: Wei sent Baba Song, minister of education and Duke of Nanping, and Yizhan Juan, Upright General and Duke of Anping, to advance and occupy Henei. Raiding General Wang Luosheng camped in Hedong to support Hong.
repairs.sourceWitness: 魏遣司徒、南平公拔拔嵩，正直將軍、安平公乙旃眷，進據河內，遊擊將軍王洛生屯於河東，為泓聲援。
repairs.sourceReason: Two dukes advance into Henei. Wang Luosheng alone is assigned Hedong. The literal instead implies that all three occupied Henei; the idiomatic conflates the assignments.

repairs.before: Liu Yu halted at Shan city and sent Shen Linzi with more than ten thousand crack troops over the mountains to join Shen Tianzi and others at Qingni, intending to attack Yaoliu.
repairs.after: Liu Yu halted at the city of Shan and sent Shen Linzi with more than ten thousand picked troops to open a route across the mountains. They were to join Shen Tianzi and the others at Qingni for an attack on Yaoliu.
repairs.sourceWitness: 劉裕次於陝城，遣沈林子率精兵萬餘，越山開道，會沈田子等於青泥，將攻堯柳。
repairs.sourceReason: 越山開道 includes opening a route across the mountains.

repairs.before: Yao Hong marched with Yao Yu to meet them.
repairs.after: Yao Hong sent Yao Yu ahead with eight thousand infantry and cavalry to oppose them. Hong himself led the main army out after him.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓使姚裕率步騎八千距之，泓躬將大眾繼發。
repairs.sourceReason: Restore Yu’s separate eight-thousand-strong force and Hong’s personal departure afterward at the head of the main army.

repairs.before: Yao Yu lost to Shen Tianzi; Yao Hong fell back to Bashang as towns went over to Jin.
repairs.after: Shen Tianzi defeated Yao Yu. Hong fell back and camped at Bashang, and many commanderies and counties in Guanzhong entered into secret communication with the Jin army.
repairs.sourceWitness: 裕為田子所敗，泓退次於灞上，關中郡縣多潛通于王師。
repairs.sourceReason: 郡縣 covers both commanderies and counties, and 潛通 means secret contact, not open submission.

repairs.before: Yu was defeated by Tianzi; Hong drew back to camp at Bashang; many Guanzhong counties secretly communicated with the royal army.
repairs.after: Shen Tianzi defeated Yao Yu. Hong fell back and camped at Bashang, and many commanderies and counties in Guanzhong entered into secret communication with the Jin army.
repairs.sourceWitness: 裕為田子所敗，泓退次於灞上，關中郡縣多潛通于王師。
repairs.sourceReason: 郡縣 covers both commanderies and counties, and 潛通 means secret contact, not open submission.

repairs.before: Liu Yu reached Tong Pass and sent the generals Zhu Chaoshi and Xu Yi to join Xue Bo north of the He to attack Puban.
repairs.after: Liu Yu reached Tong Pass and sent the generals Zhu Chaoshi and Xu Yizhi to join Xue Bo north of the Yellow River for an attack on Puban.
repairs.sourceWitness: 劉裕至潼關，遣將軍硃超石、徐猗之會薛帛于河北，以攻蒲阪。
repairs.sourceReason: 徐猗之 is the full name Xu Yizhi, confirmed by 猗之 repeated twice at s0223.

repairs.before: Liu Yu reached Tong Pass, sent generals Zhu Chaoshi and Xu Yi to join Xue Bo north of the He to attack Puban.
repairs.after: Liu Yu reached Tong Pass and sent the generals Zhu Chaoshi and Xu Yizhi to join Xue Bo north of the Yellow River for an attack on Puban.
repairs.sourceWitness: 劉裕至潼關，遣將軍硃超石、徐猗之會薛帛于河北，以攻蒲阪。
repairs.sourceReason: 徐猗之 is the full name Xu Yizhi, confirmed by 猗之 repeated twice at s0223.

repairs.before: Yao Zan faced Liu Yu; Yao Nan held Xiangcheng.
repairs.after: Yao Zan opposed Liu Yu west of the pass, and Yao Nan camped at Xiangcheng.
repairs.sourceWitness: 姚贊距裕于關西，姚難屯於香城。
repairs.sourceReason: Zan opposed Yu west of the pass.

repairs.before: Yu sent Wang Zhen'e and Wang Chong west from Qiushe to cross the Wei, pressing Nan's army.
repairs.after: Liu Yu sent Wang Zhen’e and Wang Jing west from Qiushe to cross the Wei and press Yao Nan’s army.
repairs.sourceWitness: 裕遣王鎮惡、王敬自秋社西渡渭，以逼難軍。
repairs.sourceReason: 王敬 is Wang Jing, as at s0187.

repairs.before: Yao Pu crushed Jin at Puban; Xu Yi died and Zhu Chaoshi ran.
repairs.after: Yao Pu, General Who Guards the East, and Yao Hedu defeated Xu Yizhi and the others at Puban. Xu Yizhi was killed, and Zhu Chaoshi abandoned his men and fled to Tong Pass.
repairs.sourceWitness: 鎮東姚璞及姚和都擊敗猗之等於蒲阪，猗之遇害，超石棄其眾奔於潼關。
repairs.sourceReason: Both Yao Pu and Yao Hedu defeated Xu Yizhi’s party; 鎮東 is General Who Guards the East. Restore Yizhi’s full name as at s0220 and Chaoshi’s abandonment of his troops and flight to Tong Pass.

repairs.before: General Who Conquers the East Yao Pu and Yao Hedou defeated Yi and others at Puban; Yi met death; Chaoshi abandoned his host and fled to Tong Pass.
repairs.after: Yao Pu, General Who Guards the East, and Yao Hedu defeated Xu Yizhi and the others at Puban. Xu Yizhi was killed, and Zhu Chaoshi abandoned his men and fled to Tong Pass.
repairs.sourceWitness: 鎮東姚璞及姚和都擊敗猗之等於蒲阪，猗之遇害，超石棄其眾奔於潼關。
repairs.sourceReason: Both Yao Pu and Yao Hedu defeated Xu Yizhi’s party; 鎮東 is General Who Guards the East. Restore Yizhi’s full name as at s0220 and Chaoshi’s abandonment of his troops and flight to Tong Pass.

repairs.before: Floods blocked Yao Zan from crossing the Wei.
repairs.after: Heavy rains sent the Wei River over its banks, and Yao Zan and the others could not cross to the north.
repairs.sourceWitness: 時大霖雨，渭水泛溢，贊等不得北渡。
repairs.sourceReason: Continuous heavy rain made the Wei overflow, preventing Zan and his companions from crossing north.

repairs.before: Wang Zhen'e overtook Yao Nan in the flood season.
repairs.after: Wang Zhen’e advanced by water and by land and overtook Yao Nan.
repairs.sourceWitness: 鎮惡水陸兼進，追及姚難。
repairs.sourceReason: 水陸兼進 means a coordinated advance by land and water, not an observation about flood season.

repairs.before: Yao Hong rushed to Stone Bridge to help.
repairs.after: Hong brought his army back from Bashang and halted at Stone Bridge to support Yao Nan.
repairs.sourceWitness: 泓自灞上還軍，次於石橋以援之。
repairs.sourceReason: Hong returns with his army from Bashang, camps at the bridge, and intends to aid Nan.

repairs.before: Yao Zan fell back to Zheng.
repairs.after: Yao Zan withdrew and encamped at the city of Zheng.
repairs.sourceWitness: 贊退屯鄭城。
repairs.sourceReason: 退屯 is withdrawal to camp at the specified city.

repairs.before: Yao Qiang joined Yao Nan on the Jing River line.
repairs.after: Yao Qiang, General Who Guards the North, led several thousand men of the commandery and formed ranks with Yao Nan on the Jing River to resist Wang Zhen’e.
repairs.sourceWitness: 鎮北姚彊率郡人數千，與姚難陣於涇上，以距鎮惡。
repairs.sourceReason: 鎮北 is General Who Guards the North. Restore Qiang’s several thousand local men, formation on the Jing with Nan, and objective against Zhen’e.

repairs.before: General Who Conquers the North Yao Qiang led several thousand commandery people and with Yao Nan formed array on the Jing to block Zhen'e.
repairs.after: Yao Qiang, General Who Guards the North, led several thousand men of the commandery and formed ranks with Yao Nan on the Jing River to resist Wang Zhen’e.
repairs.sourceWitness: 鎮北姚彊率郡人數千，與姚難陣於涇上，以距鎮惡。
repairs.sourceReason: 鎮北 is General Who Guards the North. Restore Qiang’s several thousand local men, formation on the Jing with Nan, and objective against Zhen’e.

repairs.before: Mao Dezu killed Yao Qiang; Yao Nan bolted for Chang'an.
repairs.after: Wang Zhen’e sent Mao Dezu against Yao Qiang and routed him. Qiang died in battle, and Yao Nan fled back to Chang’an.
repairs.sourceWitness: 鎮惡遣毛德祖擊彊，大敗，彊戰死，難遁還長安。
repairs.sourceReason: Zhen’e orders Dezu’s attack, which routs Qiang. Qiang dies fighting; no individual killer is identified.
